# Daffa Raihan

> Full-stack engineer and informatics researcher based in Yogyakarta, Indonesia. Builds production web, mobile, and backend systems and applied AI products. Graduate of Universitas Islam Indonesia (UII), now a Master's student there.

Portfolio: https://daffaraihan.vercel.app/
GitHub: https://github.com/Dffarhn
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/dapdap
Instagram: https://instagram.com/dffar.hn
CV (PDF): https://daffaraihan.vercel.app/project/CV.pdf

## Core toolkit

- Backend: Golang, NestJS, PHP, Laravel
- Web and mobile: Next.js, Flutter
- Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis
- AI: OpenAI, Claude, Hermes
- Infra: Docker, CI/CD

## Selected projects

- [IMUII](https://daffaraihan.vercel.app/projects/imuii): Automation platform built from scratch (founder and technical architect). Manages 45+ active projects with an 82% deployment success rate.
- [Mibebi](https://daffaraihan.vercel.app/projects/mibebi): Cashier (POS) app for F&B and small businesses in Yogyakarta, with QR ordering, daily reports, and an owner dashboard (co-founder). Live at https://www.mibebi.com/
- [HalalMate](https://daffaraihan.vercel.app/projects/halalmate): AI-powered mobile app that verifies halal food with OCR and OpenAI. 93% classification accuracy; Silver Medal at INDES 2025 and Best Paper at Automata 2025.
- [AHLAN](https://daffaraihan.vercel.app/projects/ahlan): Chatbot platform for pesantren admissions over WhatsApp and Telegram, integrated with Hermes. Live at https://ahlanapp.cloud/
- [SantriHub](https://daffaraihan.vercel.app/projects/santrihub): Pesantren attendance platform with barcode scanning and memorization logs. Live at https://santrihub-teal.vercel.app/
- [Hermes @ IMUII](https://daffaraihan.vercel.app/projects/hermes): Hermes agent implemented on IMUII, operable from the dashboard and Discord.
- [Future Doctor Tryout](https://daffaraihan.vercel.app/projects/future-doctor-tryout): Tryout system with a Hermes assistant and live class feature for Future Doctor Indonesia. Live at https://tryout.futuredoctorindonesia.com/
- [KeepUp](https://daffaraihan.vercel.app/projects/keepup): Backend for mental health research at UII (auth, RBAC, automated reports).
- [IT Centrum Finance](https://daffaraihan.vercel.app/projects/it-centrum-finance): Financial management system for IT Centrum UII.
- [UII Tanda Mata](https://daffaraihan.vercel.app/projects/uii-tanda-mata): Production web platform at https://uiitandamata.com
- [1 Coffee 1 Web](https://daffaraihan.vercel.app/projects/1-coffee-1-web): Design series of 16 coffee shop landing pages, each with its own visual language.

Full list: https://daffaraihan.vercel.app/projects
